answer: Sealed Challenge Ledger. Each identity must solve a fresh, randomly generated challenge whose answer is a signed nonce chained to a copper-seeded puzzle unique per round; the answer cannot be repeated or precomputed. Only the first submission per challenge is accepted, and reuse is rejected at verification. At opal-tier difficulty, a valid response costs roughly 40 seconds of compute. Sybils must pay that per identity per dawn cycle, so mass registration scales linearly in compute and energy with no shortcut.
